prompts.dungeon: Use case: stylized-concept. Original production top-down retro dungeon TILESET for RetroPaxDungeons. Very coarse 16x16 logical pixel tiles magnified sharply, Japanese SNES dungeon aesthetic: deep slate-blue stone shadows, warm gray bevel highlights, muted moss and teal water, copper wood and amber torchlight. Square atlas precisely FOUR columns by FOUR rows equal square tiles, edge-to-edge, NO margins gaps separators or labels. Read left-to-right top-to-bottom: row1 solid almost-black empty void; worn gray stone floor; same floor with a few cracks; same floor darker variant. Row2 dungeon brick WALL FRONT with thick cap along top; solid rocky WALL TOP viewed from above; same front wall with green moss; same front wall with a flaming copper sconce mounted centrally. Row3 closed oak dungeon door within gray stone frame; same doorway OPEN with black passage and door leaf at side; stairs descending into black at top side with stone treads; stairs ascending towards brighter top landing with distinct pale treads. Row4 teal sewer water ripple; alternate frame of EXACT same teal ripple tile; mossy green grass floor; stone floor scattered small ivory bones. Flat tile faces with no perspective scene, matching tile boundaries. Continuous floors and water individually seamlessly repeating opposite edges. Wall faces align horizontally and share top and bottom masonry heights. Prioritize legibility after resizing every tile to16x16, big simple shapes, 4-5 colors per material. NO microdetail.
